Sobre.title: Our story
Sobre.heroDesc: Discover the passion and philosophy behind every dish at MAYDO.
Sobre.storyP1: MAYDO was born from a dream: to create a space where the precision and elegance of Japanese cuisine could merge with the warmth of the Mediterranean. Since our beginnings in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, we have dedicated every day to perfecting this art.
Sobre.storyP2: Our team of chefs, trained in Japanese tradition, selects each ingredient with the same care an artisan chooses their tools. The result is a dining experience that honours Japanese roots while embracing the local culture.
Sobre.philoText: We believe every dish tells a story. Our mission is to bring authentic Japanese cuisine to Barcelona, respecting traditional techniques while innovating with the finest local and seasonal produce.
Sobre.teamDesc: A passionate team working every day to deliver the finest Japanese dining experience.

Reviews.title: What our customers say
Reviews.r1Text: The best Japanese buffet in Barcelona, no doubt. The sushi quality is impressive and the variety is enormous. We always come back.
Reviews.r2Text: Unbeatable value for money. The lunch buffet at €17.90 is a bargain for the quality they offer. The salmon is always fresh.
Reviews.r3Text: We went for a birthday and everything was perfect. The staff is very attentive and the food exceptional. The children loved it.
Reviews.r4Text: Incredible variety of dishes. The rolls are spectacular and the tempura is crispy as it should be. Pleasant and clean atmosphere.
Reviews.r5Text: We've been coming every week for years. Never disappoints. The team is always friendly and the food consistently good.
Reviews.r6Text: The daily menu is fantastic. 5 dishes of your choice plus a drink and coffee for €14.95. Impossible to find anything better in the area.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1Answer: We are open Tuesday to Sunday. Lunch from 1:00 PM to 4:30 PM and dinner from 8:30 PM to 11:30 PM. We are closed on Mondays.
FAQ.q2Question: Do I need to make a reservation?
FAQ.q2Answer: We recommend booking, especially on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays. You can reserve through our website or by calling +34 936 844 036.
FAQ.q3Answer: Yes, there is public parking at the Gran Via 2 shopping centre, just a 2-minute walk from the restaurant. There is also surface parking available at Plaza Europa.
FAQ.q4Question: Do you have highchairs and a children's menu?
FAQ.q4Answer: Yes, we have highchairs for young children. Our buffet has a reduced children's price: €10.90 for lunch and €12.90 for dinner for children up to 10 years old.
FAQ.q5Question: Do you cater for food allergies and intolerances?
FAQ.q5Answer: Yes, our team is prepared to handle allergies and intolerances. Each dish indicates its allergens. Please inform our staff upon arrival or when making your reservation.
FAQ.q6Answer: Yes, we accept all credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), as well as mobile payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay) and cash.
FAQ.q7Answer: Yes, we deliver to L'Hospitalet de Llobregat and surrounding areas. You can place your order directly on our website. We are also available on Uber Eats, Glovo and Just Eat.
FAQ.q8Question: Can the restaurant be booked for private events?
FAQ.q8Answer: Yes, we offer options for private events, corporate dinners and celebrations. Contact us through the form or by phone to receive a personalised quote.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.heroDesc: Information about how we protect and process your personal data.
Privacy.section1Body:
SUSHI MAYDO, located at Pl. d'Europa, 102, 08902 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelona, is responsible for the processing of your personal data.

Contact email: sushimaydobcnplazaeuropa@gmail.com
Phone: +34 936 844 036
Privacy.section2Body:
We collect personal data that you voluntarily provide through:

• Reservation form: name, email, phone, date, time, number of guests.
• Contact form: name, email, message.
• Online orders: name, email, phone, delivery address.
• Gift cards: sender and recipient name and email.
Privacy.section3Body:
Your personal data is used exclusively for:

• Managing reservations and orders.
• Responding to your enquiries and requests.
• Sending confirmation emails.
• Improving our services and user experience.
• Complying with applicable legal obligations.
Privacy.section4Body:
The processing of your data is based on:

• The consent you give when submitting a form.
• The performance of a contract (order and reservation management).
• The legitimate interest in improving our services.
• Compliance with legal obligations.
Privacy.section5Body:
Our website uses first-party and third-party cookies:

• Essential cookies: necessary for the website to function (language preference, cookie consent).
• Analytical cookies: Google Analytics to understand how our website is used (only if you accept all cookies).
• Third-party cookies: social media widgets that may set their own cookies.

You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie banner or your browser settings.
Privacy.section6Body:
In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:

• Access your personal data.
• Rectify inaccurate data.
• Request the deletion of your data.
• Object to the processing of your data.
• Request data portability.
• Withdraw your consent at any time.

To exercise these rights, contact us at sushimaydobcnplazaeuropa@gmail.com.
Privacy.section7Body: Your personal data will be retained for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected and to comply with applicable legal obligations. Reservation and order data is kept for a maximum of 2 years.
